notes: Implements the frozen debug protocol: eight native Qasper questions through Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct (revision 7ae557604adf67be50417f59c2c2f167def9a775) on CUDA in BF16, chat template + LongBench Qasper prompt, document token-truncated to a 2048-token total budget with the question preserved, greedy <=128 new tokens. answers.jsonl carries exactly id/answer/raw_text/token_ids/input_tokens/truncated and is fsynced per item; run.json carries real synchronized CUDA-event timings, versions, hashes, peak memory and seeds. serve binds only after the model is resident on CUDA and exposes GET /health plus POST /infer with 400 on absent document/question; each request is recomputed from scratch. doctor performs static file/package/CUDA checks and exits 78 when anything required is missing (0 otherwise) without loading a model. `main.py --help` and `doctor` never import torch weights. No network, no package installs, no mock weights, no CPU fallback: a missing CUDA device or missing input aborts with a prerequisite error instead of producing fake work.
